name: Farminveste, S.G.P.S., S.A.
summary: Farminveste, S.G.P.S., S.A., through its subsidiaries, engages in the pharmacies, pharmaceutical distribution, information systems, healthcare, market intelligence, real estate, and other services businesses. It distributes pharmaceutical products in Portugal; operates a network of eight hospitals and nine outpatient clinics in Lisbon, Almada, Oeiras, Cascais, Sintra, Mafra, Torres Vedras, Santarém, Coimbra, Viseu, S. João da Madeira, Matosinhos, and Porto, as well as manages Hospital de Braga and Hospital Vila Franca de Xira; and provides consultancy and technological services in the healthcare sector. The company is also involved in the market study in the health area in Portugal, Spain, Ireland, and Germany; and operation of pharmacies. In addition, it invests in the real estate sector. Farminveste, S.G.P.S., S.A. was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Lisbon, Portugal.
